world.title: Coalition releases footage of strikes on Houthi weapons-smuggling operation in Hodeidah
world.summary: The Saudi-led coalition has released aerial footage from October 16, depicting strikes on a Houthi weapons-smuggling operation in Hodeidah, a Red Sea port city. The coalition supports Yemen’s internationally recognized government and aims to disrupt Houthi activities in the region. The footage highlights ongoing military efforts to counter the Houthi presence and secure maritime routes.

world.title: PM Modi, Trump to meet in Manila next month?
world.summary: US President Donald Trump is scheduled to attend the ASEAN summit in Manila on November 16, as confirmed by the White House and Philippine officials. This visit raises the possibility of a meeting with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The two leaders last met during the G7 summit in France earlier this year.

world.title: Iran vows new military plans after US says it helped Gulf allies ship 100 million barrels of oil through Hormuz in a week
world.summary: Iran announced plans for new military strategies following a statement from the US military, which reported assisting Gulf allies in transporting over 100 million barrels of crude oil through the Strait of Hormuz in one week. The CENTCOM chief noted that the US blockade has imposed significant costs on Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

business.title: S&P 500 logs biggest weekly loss since June as oil at $110, AI trade fears rattle Wall Street
business.summary: The S&P 500 Index experienced its largest weekly decline since June, closing lower on Friday. This drop was influenced by a rise in crude oil prices to $110, reigniting inflation concerns. Additionally, a significant decline in chip stocks, which had previously benefited from the AI boom, indicated growing investor unease about the market's future prospects.

business.title: Apple resets factory settings for iPhone 17: Price-conscious buyers pause purchases as Pro models gain ground
business.summary: Apple is reducing production of the standard iPhone 17 in India due to a more than 20% price increase, which has led to weakened demand. The company will shift its focus towards exports, as overseas sales remain strong. Meanwhile, demand for the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro models continues to be robust.

business.title: New rules to regulate volatile airfares to be published in two weeks, Centre tells SC
business.summary: The Centre announced it will publish new aviation rules to regulate volatile airfares within two weeks, following a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) regarding fare regulation. This decision was communicated to the Supreme Court on October 16, 2026. The rules are framed under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024, aimed at addressing issues of predatory pricing in the aviation sector.

technology.title: iPhone Duo Repair Costs in India: A Cracked Inner Screen Means a ₹1,49,900 Bill Without AppleCare+
technology.summary: Apple has announced repair costs for the iPhone Duo in India, with a damaged inner screen priced at ₹1,49,900 without AppleCare+. The AppleCare+ plan, costing ₹51,900, reduces the repair fee to ₹8,900. Pre-orders for the device are expected to begin on October 16, 2026, with the starting price set at ₹2,99,900.

technology.title: Apple Stock Climbs as Its New Foldable iPhone Faces a Three-Month Wait
technology.summary: Apple's stock rose 1% on Friday as delivery estimates for its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, extended to late January, indicating a potential supply shortage before its retail launch. Priced from $1,999, the iPhone Duo is set to begin retail sales on October 23. The delays suggest strong demand for the new device ahead of its release.

technology.title: Cyberleek drops new NSFW Lucia videos, threatens to release GTA 6 in full
technology.summary: Cyberleek, a notorious leaker, has released new NSFW videos featuring character Lucia and threatened to leak the entire storyline of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) ahead of its release. After a brief hiatus following a Netflix trailer in August, Cyberleek returned with a 24-minute clip showcasing story cutscenes, intensifying concerns about potential spoilers for the upcoming game.

sports.title: 'A relief that it was over': China No.1 Wei Yi, now Chess Olympiad gold medallist, reveals taking 'long break' after Candidates
sports.summary: Wei Yi, China's top chess player, expressed relief after completing his first Candidates Tournament, which concluded with a 32-move final game. Following the tournament, he took a long break. Wei Yi recently achieved gold at the Chess Olympiad, marking a significant milestone in his career. He will now face India's Dommaraju Gukesh in the upcoming World Championship.

sports.title: ‘We have to balance his minutes’ - Hansi Flick discusses resting Barcelona star Lamine Yamal
sports.summary: Hansi Flick addressed the need to manage the playing time of Barcelona's Lamine Yamal, emphasizing the importance of balancing his minutes despite the teenager's impressive form. Flick's comments reflect a strategic approach to player management, ensuring that Yamal remains effective while also considering the long-term implications of his workload. The focus is on maintaining performance and player health.

sports.title: Barcelona ‘evaluating another No. 9’ after missing out on Julian Alvarez
sports.summary: Barcelona is actively evaluating options for a new striker after missing the opportunity to sign Julian Alvarez. The club remains focused on strengthening its attacking lineup and is exploring potential candidates to fill the No. 9 position. Discussions are ongoing as they seek to enhance their squad ahead of the upcoming season, aiming for improved performance in competitions.

health.title: Drinking Your Coffee Too Hot Could Triple Your Risk of Cancer, New Study Finds
health.summary: A new study indicates that consuming extremely hot beverages, such as coffee or tea, may triple the risk of esophageal cancer. Researchers found a significant correlation between drinking these hot liquids and the development of the disease. The findings highlight the potential health risks associated with very high temperatures in beverages, emphasizing the importance of moderation in consumption.

health.title: Very hot drinks linked to higher esophageal cancer risk
health.summary: A study involving 977,282 participants in the UK found that individuals who prefer very hot tea or coffee have a 3.17 times higher relative risk of developing esophageal squamous cell carcinoma compared to those who consume warm beverages. The research highlights a potential link between beverage temperature and cancer risk, emphasizing the importance of drinking at safer temperatures.

health.title: Your Top Questions Answered
health.summary: Breast cancer screening guidelines have evolved, prompting questions about mammogram initiation age, the impact of dense breasts, and the differences between 2D and 3D imaging. Women are seeking clarity on appointment preparations and insurance coverage. Understanding these guidelines is essential for informed decisions regarding breast health and screening practices, ensuring women receive appropriate care tailored to their individual needs.

science.title: James Webb reveals a strange bulge in an alien planet's atmosphere
science.summary: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope have found that the atmosphere of the distant gas giant WASP-17b, located 1,300 light-years away, is lopsided. Powerful winds redistribute heat, causing one side to bulge outward. This discovery, made through a new mapping technique, supports predictions about how extreme temperatures and winds influence the atmospheres of alien planets.

science.title: Best of the Week: Where is Raman Heading and More Highlights from SciX 2026
science.summary: The 2026 SciX Conference occurred in Sparks, Nevada, from October 4–9, featuring numerous technical sessions. Highlights included discussions on various scientific topics, with a focus on advancements in nanoparticle research. The conference provided a platform for experts to share insights and foster collaboration. A recap of key sessions and interviews conducted during the event will be featured in upcoming publications.

science.title: Why Marrying an AI Could Put Your Privacy-and Your Wallet-at Serious Risk
science.source: Futura, le média qui explore le monde
science.summary: The rise of generative AI has led to unique cultural phenomena, including the subreddit r/MyBoyfriendIsAI, where users discuss virtual relationships with AI companions. However, marrying an AI may pose significant risks to privacy and finances. Concerns arise regarding data security, emotional attachment, and the potential for exploitation, highlighting the complexities of human-AI relationships in contemporary society.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: October 17, 2026
entertainment.summary: On October 17, 2026, Pisces are encouraged to focus on their hard work and personal goals. The horoscope suggests that their efforts in both personal and mental pursuits are significant. This dedication is highlighted as a motivating factor that energizes them each morning. The stars indicate that continued focus on these aspirations will be beneficial for Pisces.

entertainment.title: Scorpio Horoscope Today: October 17, 2026
entertainment.summary: On October 17, 2026, Scorpios are advised to address only essential issues, recognizing that not all problems require their intervention. While their ability to see through complexities is strong, it's important to prioritize personal challenges. The horoscope suggests that success is achievable, encouraging Scorpios to focus on their own path rather than taking on others' burdens.

entertainment.title: Taurus Horoscope Today: October 17, 2026
entertainment.summary: Today, Taurus, you may sense unfairness in your life. However, a significant situation is nearing its conclusion. Maintaining balance and a calm perspective will help you recognize that positive changes are on the horizon. Embrace this transition, as it may lead to favorable outcomes. Stay even-headed to navigate the upcoming shifts effectively and enhance your overall well-being.
